confidence_notes: I used one web search for food and drink prices. It returned cost-of-living sites that give quite different figures, and one of them (traveltables) was last updated in July 2023. Tulum Times peso prices put coffee at about 71 MXN and dinner for two at about 1,000 MXN. I set the food and drink anchors near or above the middle of the reported ranges because typical tourist pricing in Tulum is higher than the resident-oriented averages. Beer: sources gave roughly 2 to 3 USD, and I raised it slightly for tourist venues. Cappuccino: about 2.5 to 4 USD. Inexpensive meal: about 4 to 15 USD, with a 150 MXN set lunch reported. Mid-range dinner for two: about 30 to 60 USD, and I set it higher for Tulum's tourist dining. I did not search cocktail or wine prices directly. I estimated them from the local relationship to beer and Tulum's beach-resort pricing, so they are less certain. All accommodation anchors are general-knowledge estimates, not checked against listings. Tulum's room rates are high and vary a lot by season and by town versus beach zone, and July is shoulder or rainy season, so treat accommodation as low-to-medium confidence.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with Playa del Carmen and Cancun's hotel zone, which are Caribbean resort cities in Quintana Roo with prices well above the Mexican national average. Tulum town prices were placed between Playa del Carmen and the more expensive beach-zone pricing.
